description: Source code for the PluginManager class in the Revive Adserver project, managing plugin package installation, upgrade, enable/disable, and related operations.

classes.name: OX_PluginManager
classes.description: Manages plugin packages, including installation, upgrade, enabling/disabling, and dependency handling within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: getPathToPackages
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to the directory containing plugin packages.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a plugin with the given name is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: _runExtensionTasks
methods.description: Executes extension hooks for specified plugin events.

methods.name: _getParsedPackage
methods.description: Returns the parsed package data.

methods.name: _getParsedPlugins
methods.description: Returns the parsed plugins data.

methods.name: upgradePackage
methods.description: Handles upgrading a plugin package from an uploaded file, including parsing, version comparison, and dependency checks.

methods.name: unpackPlugin
methods.description: Unpacks a plugin package file, verifying its contents and extracting files.

methods.name: installPackageCodeOnly
methods.description: Installs plugin code and schema from a package file without enabling.

methods.name: installPackage
methods.description: Installs a plugin package, including parsing, component installation, and configuration.

methods.name: uninstallPackage
methods.description: Uninstalls a plugin package, removing files and configuration.

methods.name: _canUninstallPlugin
methods.description: Checks if a plugin group can be safely uninstalled based on dependencies.

methods.name: enablePackage
methods.description: Enables a plugin package and its components.

methods.name: disablePackage
methods.description: Disables a plugin package and its components.

methods.name: _deleteCompiledTemplates
methods.description: Clears cached compiled templates.

methods.name: _deleteCacheMenu
methods.description: Clears cached admin menu data.

methods.name: _matchPackageFilename
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the package name and parses filename for version info.

methods.name: _parsePackageFilename
methods.description: Extracts package name and version from filename.

methods.name: _parseComponentGroups
methods.description: Parses plugin component group XML files into internal data structures.

methods.name: _canUpgradeComponentGroups
methods.description: Checks if component groups can be upgraded.

methods.name: _upgradeComponentGroups
methods.description: Upgrades component groups to new versions.

methods.name: _installComponentGroups
methods.description: Installs component groups from parsed data.

methods.name: _uninstallComponentGroups
methods.description: Uninstalls component groups.

methods.name: _setPackage
methods.description: Sets the enabled/disabled status of a package in configuration.

methods.name: _parsePackage
methods.description: Parses package XML file into internal data structure.

methods.name: parseXML
methods.description: Parses XML files, delegating to parent class.

methods.name: _registerPackage
methods.description: Registers a package in configuration (sets enabled).

methods.name: _unregisterPackage
methods.description: Removes package from configuration.

methods.name: getPackagesList
methods.description: Returns list of all installed packages with status.

methods.name: getPackageInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about a package, including files and components.

methods.name: getPackageDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic info about a package and its plugins.

methods.name: getComponentHooks
methods.description: Returns registered hook components for plugins.

methods.name: _unpack
methods.description: Determines file format, decompresses zip packages, and verifies contents.

methods.name: _checkPackageContents
methods.description: Validates contents of uploaded package zip file.

methods.name: _decompressFile
methods.description: Decompresses zip file to target directory.

methods.name: _switchToPluginLog
methods.description: Switches logging context to plugin logs.

methods.name: _switchToDefaultLog
methods.description: Restores default logging context.
